title: Draft notice after leaving the church

tellings.quote: feel that secure. So I I left. Right. As soon as I left the church, I got a notice from selective service that I was being drafted.

plain: Peter Levenda, a writer on secret history, says that in the late 1960s in New York he left the church he had been part of because he no longer felt secure there. He says that as soon as he left, he got a notice from Selective Service, the US system that called young men into the military, saying he was being drafted.
